highlights: ✨ Live sessions: two new session types — Gather brings everyone to one place (with a prompt, a backdrop, a view-only mark and an audience) and Respond collects answers that stay hidden until the host reveals them; sessions can also run over the shared Yjs doc, and anyone can claim host while the host is away (#1517, #1518, #1525, #1527, #1528, #1532).

✨ Tabletop: a new plugin with zones that hold and lay out cards or pieces (pile, spread, grid or free, aligned left, center or right) and player views that hold each player's camera on their part of the table; container auto-attach gains attachHit and accepts (#1555, #1556, #1563, #1566).

✨ Permissions: hosts connect their permission system through createApp({ permissions }), plugins ask ctx.permissions, and HUD actions, settings and panels declare requires to hide themselves; the HUD also gains side panels and a status line (#1560, #1562).
✨ Demo app: try a board without signing in at /try instead of the board list, and the world map Playground is now an elevation map (#1535, #1559).
✨ Text: the cornerResize option scales the text itself from the corner handles (#1515).

✨ Multi-page boards: several pages in one board, each its own Y.Doc loaded only when opened, with a HUD page panel, moving or copying shapes between pages, presenting and exporting across pages, and migration for existing boards (#1432, #1437, #1445, #1446, #1450, #1453).

✨ Elevation: heightfield terrain with an infinite seed-generated landscape, brushes to raise, lower, smooth, flatten or terrace, a WebGL mesh in 3D views, ground decals and road grading (#1386, #1390, #1393, #1409, #1492).

✨ 3D in core: the 3D camera, layer and shape 3D data (ShapeData.view3d) and the board height (ctx.height) move into core, drawn by the new CSS 3D renderer or the experimental GPU 3D renderer; shapes can be selected and moved while in 3D and are hidden behind hills (#1465, #1468, #1471, #1474, #1485, #1505, #1511).
✨ Board history: Git-like versions kept by the board server, with a HUD panel to list, diff, preview and restore them; it replaces the old snapshot Time Travel (#1306, #1428, #1430).
✨ Keymap: plugins' key conflicts are detected and resolved through ctx.keymap, and a Key Settings panel rebinds every plugin's keys in one place (#1425, #1429, #1431).
✨ 3D Shapes: stand shapes up from the ground in Mode 7 as panels, boxes or floating objects, with per-type 3D looks and character collision (#1358, #1362, #1367, #1368).
✨ Croupier: play turn-based croupier games on the board with table and seat shapes — no game server needed (#1338).
✨ Character: multi-jump and hover, a jump button for touch controls via setVirtualInput, and sprites that stand up in 3D views (#1300, #1350, #1382).
✨ Free Draw: hosts can add their own pens and read the current pen / color / width, and stroke ends can snap to nearby strokes of the same pen (#1364, #1379, #1384).
⚡️ Perf: drag, hover and presence updates no longer rescan every shape or redraw idle overlays across snap, select, connectors, presence and more (#1305, #1309, #1322, #1333, #1334).
✨ Live Sessions: server-authoritative voting with mid-join, reconnect grace, host handoff and secret ballots — a framework you extend with your own session types (#924).
✨ New packages: @edv4h/usketch-plugin-session (framework) + @edv4h/usketch-session-voting (first event type). Old @edv4h/usketch-plugin-voting is deprecated (#924).
✨ Map: public tool-state stores (toolStateStore / MAP_MODES / useMapToolState) so hosts can drive the map tool from custom UIs (#927).
✨ Sync: new MSG_SESSION channel (sendSession / onSession) for server-processed session messages (#924).
✨ AI Copilot: ghost shapes stream in as you sketch.
✨ AI Voice: NL2Canvas — 「不作成の矩形を主要エリアに」で初期配置を生成.
✨ Presentation mode now supports laser pointer and spotlight overlays.
♻️ Refactored sync layer: awareness events moved to EventBus.
🐛 Fix: sticky note z‑order regressed after group ungrouping.
🐛 Fix: connector reroute missed when the attached shape rotated.
⚡️ Perf: QuadTree rebuild deferred to idle callback — ~40% faster first‑paint.
✨ TransientRegistry: ephemeral objects (cursors, ripples, ghosts) get their own lifecycle.
✨ Shape Island plugin — soft regions grouping shapes by proximity.
📚 Docs: every concept page now has a live example inline.
🎉 Initial stable release of the plugin‑first rewrite (#565).
✨ Real‑time collab with Yjs + Cloudflare Durable Objects.
✨ 50+ first‑party plugins ship with the reference app.
